name: zos-platform
description: ZOS Platform monorepo — Z Mobility, Z Jobs, Z Find and shared platform capabilities.

scripts.jobs:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@zjobs/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zjobs/api
scripts.check: npm run jobs:typecheck && npm run find:check && npm run mobility:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run jobs:test && npm run find:test && npm run mobility:test
scripts.build: npm run find:build && npm run mobility:build
scripts.find:build: npm run build:zfind --workspace=z-find-platform && npm run build:admin --workspace=z-find-platform && npm run build:partner --workspace=z-find-platform
